Preline UI Advanced Select Demo

1. Basic Advanced Select

A fully functional advanced select with default styling.

<select data-hs-select='{...options}' class="hidden">
  <option value="">Choose option</option>
  <option>Name</option>
</select>

2. Select with Icon Placeholder

Custom placeholder containing an SVG icon.

3. Multiple Selection

Select multiple options at once (note the `multiple` attribute).

4. Select with Empty Option Allowed

Users can select the empty "Choose option..." placeholder.
